```{r} 
#| label: datamanip
#| warning: false
load("cxr_data.RData")
library(janitor)
library(tidyverse)

# we'll get into data wrangling soon!
# this code makes a binary version of ai_prob with 0.5 and over classified as abnormal
cxr <- cxr_cases %>%
  mutate(
    ai_abnormal = case_when(
      is.na(ai_prob) ~ NA,
      ai_prob >= 0.5 ~ 1,
      TRUE           ~ 0
    )
  )

cxr %>% #making some pretty labels for plotting table
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth,
                   levels = c(0, 1),
                   labels = c("Normal", "Abnormal")),
    ai_abnormal = factor(ai_abnormal,
                         levels = c(0, 1),
                         labels = c("AI predicts normal",
                                    "AI predicts abnormal"))
  ) %>%
  tabyl(ai_abnormal, truth) %>%
  adorn_totals(c("row", "col"))

cxr2 <- cxr_cases %>%
  mutate(
    ai_abnormal2 = case_when(
      is.na(ai_prob) ~ NA,
      ai_prob >= 0.01 ~ 1, #this is probably not a good cutpoint!
      TRUE           ~ 0
    )
  )
cxr2 %>% #making some pretty labels for plotting
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth,
                   levels = c(0, 1),
                   labels = c("Normal", "Abnormal")),
    ai_abnormal2 = factor(ai_abnormal2,
                         levels = c(0, 1),
                         labels = c("AI predicts normal",
                                    "AI predicts abnormal"))
  ) %>%
  tabyl(ai_abnormal2, truth) %>%
  adorn_totals(c("row", "col"))


```
